knownCouplings.reason: The public module exports quest generation and grant logic; grant logic requires a run ledger and optional account callbacks.
Awakening and investment ports also contain Font access, world-position, presentation and dirty notifications.
Owned in-memory rules retain SDK save-envelope and account-save notification conventions; no filesystem is imported.
Current comprehensive orchestration is account-shaped. The new character facade must not require this owner.

performance.budgetPolicy: Capture a baseline before optimization, then freeze numeric budgets. No unavailable workload or unmeasured device is marked qualified.

targets.secondary: Named older mobile hardware, separate qualification

contentFamilies.note: Exact top-level skill families from the pinned catalogue. Routing assigns required work, not executable acceptance. Nested discriminators, authored fields and source-rule references remain in the generated census.
